title: Electrical & Automation Engineer
description: Lead the design, installation, and commissioning of electrical control systems and industrial automation solutions for clients across mining, manufacturing, and commercial sectors. You'll be the technical backbone of our Engineering Solutions team, translating client requirements into safe, reliable, and efficient systems.
responsibilities: Design and size electrical control panels, distribution boards, and protection schemes
Program and commission PLCs, HMIs, and SCADA systems for industrial clients
Configure and troubleshoot variable frequency drives (VFDs) and motor control systems
Carry out site surveys, load calculations, and technical proposals for new projects
Supervise installation teams and ensure work meets electrical safety codes
Prepare as-built drawings, test reports, and commissioning documentation
Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and technicians
requirements: Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or Industrial Automation
3+ years of hands-on experience with PLC programming (Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or similar)
Solid understanding of power distribution, protection relays, and control panel design
Experience with SCADA platforms and industrial networking (Modbus, Profibus, Ethernet/IP)
Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to client sites
Strong report-writing and client communication skills
Registration with EIZ (Engineering Institution of Zambia) is an added advantage

title: Industrial Automation Technician
description: Support the installation, wiring, and maintenance of automation systems on client sites, working closely with our engineering team to keep production lines and control systems running reliably.
responsibilities: Install and wire control panels, sensors, actuators, and field instrumentation
Assist with PLC I/O testing, loop checks, and system commissioning
Perform routine preventive maintenance on automated equipment
Diagnose and repair faults on control circuits and automated machinery
Maintain accurate maintenance logs and spare-parts records
Follow lockout-tagout and site safety procedures at all times
requirements: Diploma or Trade Certificate in Electrical, Instrumentation, or Automation Engineering
2+ years of experience in panel wiring, instrumentation, or industrial maintenance
Basic knowledge of PLC/HMI systems and control circuit reading
Comfortable working at heights, in confined spaces, and on active industrial sites
Good physical fitness and a strong safety mindset
Own basic hand tools and PPE is an advantage

title: Renewable Energy (Solar) Engineer
description: Design and deliver solar PV and hybrid power solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial clients, from initial site assessment through to installation and handover.
responsibilities: Conduct site assessments and energy audits to size solar PV and battery systems
Design grid-tied, off-grid, and hybrid solar systems using industry design software
Prepare technical proposals, single-line diagrams, and bills of materials
Supervise installation of panels, inverters, battery banks, and mounting structures
Commission systems and train clients on operation and monitoring
Ensure all installations comply with relevant electrical and safety standards
requirements: Diploma or Degree in Electrical Engineering or Renewable Energy Systems
2+ years of experience designing or installing solar PV systems
Familiarity with inverter brands such as Victron, Deye, Growatt, or similar
Working knowledge of solar design tools (PVsyst, AutoCAD, or equivalent)
Strong understanding of battery storage technologies (lithium and lead-acid)
Willingness to travel for site surveys and installations

title: Network & Security Systems Engineer
description: Design, deploy, and maintain structured networks, CCTV, and access control systems for commercial and industrial clients, ensuring their sites are connected, monitored, and secure.
responsibilities: Design and install structured cabling, LAN/WAN networks, and wireless infrastructure
Configure switches, routers, and firewalls for client networks
Install and configure CCTV, access control, and intrusion detection systems
Set up remote monitoring and video management platforms
Perform network audits and recommend security improvements
Provide after-installation support and troubleshoot connectivity issues
requirements: Diploma or Degree in Computer/Network Engineering, IT, or related field
3+ years of experience in structured cabling and network installation
Hands-on experience with CCTV and access control systems (Hikvision, Dahua, or similar)
Networking certification (CCNA or equivalent) preferred
Understanding of IP networking, VLANs, and basic firewall configuration
Strong troubleshooting skills and a customer-focused attitude

title: ICT & Technical Support Specialist
description: Be the first point of contact for client technology needs — setting up hardware, software, and basic networks, and resolving day-to-day IT issues for our growing client base.
responsibilities: Install, configure, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, and peripherals
Set up business software, email systems, and basic office networks
Provide first-line technical support to clients by phone, remote access, or on-site
Maintain an inventory of equipment, licenses, and support tickets
Assist engineers with technology components of larger automation and security projects
Document recurring issues and contribute to internal knowledge base
requirements: Diploma or Certificate in Information Technology or Computer Science
1+ years of experience in IT support or helpdesk roles
Working knowledge of Windows, basic networking, and common office software
Excellent problem-solving skills and patience with non-technical clients
Good communication skills in English
A+ / N+ certification is an added advantage

title: Project Engineer
description: Plan and coordinate multidisciplinary engineering projects from consultation through to commissioning, keeping scope, budget, and schedule on track while liaising with clients and site teams.
responsibilities: Develop project plans, timelines, and resource schedules for engineering projects
Coordinate between engineering, procurement, and installation teams
Track project budgets, variations, and progress against milestones
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution
Conduct site progress meetings and prepare status reports
Ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, and to specification
requirements: Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, or Industrial) or Project Management
4+ years of experience managing technical or construction-related projects
Strong organizational skills and experience with project scheduling tools
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities
PMP or similar project management certification is an added advantage

title: Field Service & Maintenance Engineer
description: Deliver on-site maintenance, fault-finding, and repair services for automation, electrical, and equipment installations under active service contracts with our clients.
responsibilities: Respond to client call-outs for equipment faults and breakdowns
Carry out scheduled preventive maintenance visits per service contracts
Diagnose electrical, mechanical, and control system faults on site
Order and manage spare parts for repairs and maintenance work
Complete service reports and update client maintenance histories
Recommend upgrades or improvements based on equipment condition
requirements: Diploma in Electrical, Mechanical, or Mechatronics Engineering
2+ years of experience in field service, plant maintenance, or equipment repair
Strong fault-finding skills across electrical and mechanical systems
Valid driver's license and willingness to travel extensively within the region
Ability to work independently and manage time across multiple client sites
Good communication skills for client-facing service visits

title: Instrumentation & Control Engineer
description: Specify, calibrate, and integrate process instrumentation and control loops for industrial clients, ensuring accurate measurement and reliable automatic control across their operations.
responsibilities: Specify and select field instrumentation (flow, level, pressure, temperature)
Calibrate and commission instruments and control loops
Develop control narratives and loop diagrams for new installations
Integrate instrumentation with PLC/SCADA systems
Troubleshoot instrumentation and control loop faults on site
Support hazardous area classification and compliance where required
requirements: Degree or Diploma in Instrumentation, Electrical, or Control Systems Engineering
3+ years of experience in process instrumentation and control
Practical knowledge of 4-20mA, HART, and digital fieldbus protocols
Experience calibrating and maintaining industrial instrumentation
Understanding of P&IDs and control loop documentation
Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to fault-finding

title: Business Development Engineer
description: Drive growth for SEAW by identifying new business opportunities, building client relationships, and translating technical capabilities into winning proposals across our five service lines.
responsibilities: Identify and pursue new business opportunities across target industries
Build and maintain relationships with key clients, contractors, and suppliers
Prepare technical and commercial proposals in collaboration with engineering teams
Represent SEAW at industry events, tenders, and client meetings
Track the sales pipeline and report on business development performance
Gather market intelligence to inform service and product offerings
requirements: Degree in Engineering, Business, or a related technical field
3+ years of experience in technical sales or business development, ideally in engineering or industrial services
Ability to understand and communicate technical solutions to non-technical clients
Strong negotiation, presentation, and proposal-writing skills
Existing network within mining, manufacturing, or commercial sectors is an advantage
Valid driver's license and willingness to travel

title: Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Officer
description: Champion a strong safety culture across all SEAW project sites, ensuring installation, automation, and maintenance work is carried out safely and in line with regulatory requirements.
responsibilities: Conduct site risk assessments and develop method statements for project work
Carry out toolbox talks, safety inductions, and routine site inspections
Monitor compliance with PPE, lockout-tagout, and working-at-height procedures
Investigate incidents and near-misses, and recommend corrective actions
Maintain HSE documentation and statutory compliance records
Advise project and engineering teams on safe systems of work
requirements: Diploma or Certificate in Occupational Health and Safety or related field
2+ years of experience in an HSE role, ideally in construction, mining, or industrial settings
Working knowledge of Zambian occupational health and safety regulations
Strong observation skills and the confidence to enforce safety standards
Excellent communication and report-writing skills
NEBOSH certification or equivalent is an added advantage
